verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single 2015-era community comment that UE 4.7 'can export to HTML5'. That is a glancing, dated mention, with no first-party documentation of a current browser/WebGL target. The other platform evidence (cooking and packaging for target platforms, the 'All platforms' license line) never names the web. Missing for 10: current first-party WebGL/HTML5 export docs, any evidence of reasonable payload size, any WebGPU support or roadmap, and hands-on corroboration that browser builds work today.
